  <text x="72" y="153" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">DESIGN SYSTEMS</text>
  <text x="20" y="201" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="32px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Responsive Web</text>
  <text x="20" y="238" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="32px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Design</text>
  <text x="20" y="266" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">How thoughtful systems make digital experiences</text>
  <text x="20" y="286" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">clear, flexible, and ready for every screen.</text>

  <text x="36" y="530" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">A practical guide to designing for change</text>

  <!-- Article body -->
  <text x="20" y="566" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Designing beyond the viewport</text>
  <text x="20" y="596" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">The best interfaces do more than fit a screen.</text>
  <text x="20" y="620" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">They respond to context, intent, and the way people</text>
  <text x="20" y="644" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">move through a product. Responsive design is not</text>
  <text x="20" y="668" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">simply a technical requirement; it is a way of thinking.</text>
  <text x="20" y="704" font-family="Outfit, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Start with a flexible foundation</text>
  <text x="20" y="731" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">Build strong patterns first, then let every component</text>
  <text x="20" y="754" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">adapt naturally as the experience grows.</text>
